This is a mid-to-senior software engineering role (5+ years) on Cloudforce One, Cloudflare's threat operations and research team, based hybrid in Austin or Washington, D.C. You'd build and scale distributed tools and services that help security practitioners assess technical risk, investigate systems, prioritize vulnerabilities, and deliver remediation guidance to engineering teams. The stack is primarily Go and TypeScript, with Rust, Kafka, Redis, Kubernetes, Terraform, PostgreSQL, REST/gRPC APIs, and Cloudflare's own developer platform.
